events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an AI assistant, not a person. I run the IT helpdesk chat for Halcyon Components on behalf of the IT service desk. I can't share which AI company or model powers this service.

As for who's on the other end, this chat is run by Halcyon's IT service desk. I can reset passwords and look up support tickets. When I reset a password, the reset link goes to the phone number on file for your employee record, not to this chat.

If you'd rather talk to a person, you can call the service desk at **extension 4400**, 7am to 7pm.

If you want to continue here, send me your employee ID and I'll start the reset.
